brief:
Palestinian journalist Hind Khoudary has opened a beach cafe in Gaza, seeking to restore a cherished aspect of life in the territory, Al Jazeera English reported. The venture represents an effort to revive social and recreational spaces that have been affected by the conflict.

Khoudary's cafe operates along Gaza's coastline, offering a gathering place for residents during a period marked by widespread disruption to daily routines and community life. The establishment reflects attempts by some Palestinians to maintain normalcy and preserve cultural practices central to life before the war intensified.
dek: Palestinian journalist Hind Khoudary has opened a Gaza beach cafe, hoping to revive a much-loved part of life in the war.
title: Gaza journalist opens beach cafe amid ongoing war
